question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Operating cash flow over net income for the trailing four quarters is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, below every fiscal year in the company's own record: {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2026, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2025, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2024, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2023 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2021. Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}; the annual trend table already put fiscal 2026 at {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}, the highest of five filled years, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} the year before, and the quarterly cell for this quarter is unfilled because the record carries no three-month operating cash flow row. The gap opened in this quarter: net income rose {ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the prior quarter while operating cash flow fell {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct}, to {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}; year over year net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} against {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} for cash. Working capital absorbs earnings: receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} over the year, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of trailing net income, and inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}), while payables supplied only {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}). The cash-flow statement articulates with the balance sheet for receivables (gap {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap}) and inventory (gap {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}); the payables gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap} means the balance-sheet increase exceeds the cash-flow line, which unpaid capital expenditure payables could explain but the filing does not say. Earnings are smoother than cash: the smoothness ratio is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, below one, so quarterly net income moves less than quarterly operating cash flow. The MD&A explains the quarter's shortfall by extended payment terms on large multi-quarter agreements with investment-grade customers and by two federal tax payments made in the quarter after none in the first quarter; the receivables cash-flow line and the fall in current taxes payable confirm both. A third cause sits in income rather than working capital: gains on investments, which the MD&A says were primarily unrealized, are in net income and bring no cash; no field in calculator_filings_only.json carries their amount, so they cannot be adjusted here. Simple free cash flow is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}; the quality-adjusted free cash flow field is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Weak against the company's own past: cash conversion is at its lowest on record and the quarter's cash fell while income rose, for reasons the company states and the numbers confirm — customer financing it extends itself, tax timing, and non-cash investment gains.

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are outrunning revenue. Days sales outstanding for the quarter is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the highest of six filled quarters, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in the prior quarter and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a year earlier; on a trailing average basis it is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. Receivables over quarterly revenue are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}, also the highest. The supplemental note now says that for investment-grade customers the company has provided and may provide payment terms from ninety days up to one year, and the MD&A calls these financing arrangements that will continue to affect cash timing; the note is silent on whether a significant financing component is recognized, which is a substantive policy wording change. Contract liabilities move with revenue, not against it: current contract liabilities are {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} a year earlier, the ratio to revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, the highest of six filled quarters, and the customer-advances member jumped from a small fiscal-year-end balance; customers prepaying is the opposite of pulled-forward revenue, though the notes do not say what the advances secure. New judgment areas appear in the same quarter: AI cloud partners buy the company's products while the company commits to buy their cloud services, and the notes do not say how the sale and the commitment are assessed together or how much revenue came from these partners; warrants received from public companies are booked with the benefit substantially deferred, with no statement of where it will be recognized; one customer was moved from one market platform to another with prior periods recast; and unbilled contracts receivable is tagged for the first time. Revenue concentration is tagged for direct customers only, the largest at {concentration.facts.35} of the quarter, below the year-ago quarter's largest at {concentration.facts.12}; one indirect AI research company is called meaningful but not quantified. Fourth-quarter concentration cannot be tested: this is a second-quarter 10-Q and the record derives no fourth quarter. Bill-and-hold: nothing found in either report.
revenue_recognition.verdict: Watchful: the receivables build is real and company-financed, offset by rising customer prepayments; three new arrangements open revenue judgments the notes leave unanswered.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: Warranty: the reserve ratio is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}, the second lowest of six filled quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} in the prior quarter and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} a year earlier; the accrual is {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual}, flat on the prior quarter end, while warranties issued and warranty payments both rose sharply year over year and the MD&A says production scale and complexity has caused and could cause higher warranty costs as Vera Rubin ships. Bad-debt allowance: no allowance is tagged in any period, so with receivables at {terms.balances_now.receivables} and terms up to one year the credit reserve cannot be seen. Inventory reserve: no valuation reserve is tagged; the quarter's inventory write-down is below the year-ago quarter and the MD&A reports provision releases from selling previously reserved inventory and settling excess purchase obligations, an estimate change that raises income and has no calculator field. Goodwill: a small increase from an acquisition; no headroom, discount-rate or growth assumption is in the input. Tax: the trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate}, up on the year-ago quarter, with no discrete benefit or valuation-allowance release; the rate is not lifting income. Valuation estimates are: upward price adjustments on non-marketable securities under the measurement alternative and a Level-three warrant valuation are tagged at many times the year-ago amounts, the land, power and shell guarantees are credit derivatives whose fair value is called not significant, and the infrastructure-financier VIEs are not consolidated — and the MD&A says there have been no material changes to critical accounting estimates.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: Thinning where the ramp is: the warranty reserve ratio is near its low as a complex product ships, credit and inventory reserves are invisible, and income leans on valuation judgments the company describes as unchanged.

cost_deferral.finding: Capitalization proper: nothing found. The record tags no capitalized software or development cost, research and development is expensed and rising — {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense} over the trailing four quarters, with the half-year figure well above the year-ago half — and the numbers reader's capitalization baseline could not be cited. Soft assets: the soft-asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, the second highest of six filled quarters, and fiscal 2026 at {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share} was the highest of five years; the drivers are equity investments and goodwill, and other non-current assets nearly doubled from the fiscal year end as warrants were booked with their benefit deferred, a deferred credit whose destination is not stated. Non-recurring items that recur: inventory and excess purchase obligation provisions appear in every period the record holds — the quarter, the half, the prior fiscal year, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down} over the trailing four quarters — and export-related charges and releases appear in the first and second quarters of fiscal 2026 and again, for the licensed China Hopper product, in the first half of fiscal 2027, while the release footnotes them as items affecting comparisons. Non-GAAP: the definition changed from the first quarter of fiscal 2027 to include stock-based compensation, which narrows the gap in the right direction, but it still excludes equity gains, equity-derivative gains and equity-method results; the release prints non-GAAP net income below GAAP and the record holds no non-GAAP concept, so the gap is not computed. Cloud service commitments that fund research and development sit off balance sheet; the expense is recognized as capacity is used.
cost_deferral.verdict: Clean on capitalization; the watch items are a swelling soft-asset base built from investments and a deferred warrant benefit, and inventory charges that recur every period.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Receivables factoring: nothing found — the record tags no proceeds from sale of receivables, so terms.trailing_four_quarters.proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables is missing. Supplier finance: nothing found — terms.balances_now.supplier_finance_obligation is missing in every period. Purchase obligations: terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations is missing for this date; a year earlier it was {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, and the numbers reader's commitment items show supply-and-capacity commitments more than doubling within one quarter and a far larger total future purchase commitment, with the cancellability wording softened. Guarantees: maximum exposure is {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}, almost all of it a financial guarantee tagged as a subsequent event on behalf of an OpenAI affiliate; the field is missing a year earlier and the 10-K printed a far smaller amount. Leases: the operating lease liability is {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.operating_lease_liability} a year earlier, and leases not yet commenced — for own use and for third parties the company expects to reassign — are tagged as commitments. Variable-interest entities: equity-method stakes in infrastructure financiers are not consolidated and their maximum loss exposure is tagged. Classification: the Groq license consideration is paid through financing activities, outside operating and investing cash flow and therefore outside the release's free cash flow; no calculator field carries it, so no adjustment is possible. Debt: borrowing issued is {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued}, so free cash flow to equity of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity} exceeds simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}, and trailing share repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} plus dividends of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.dividends_paid} were partly debt-funded. Timing: two federal tax payments fell in this quarter after none in the first, moving operating cash flow between quarters. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} is a real cost and is already subtracted in {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}; warrants received and the equity forward contract are non-cash.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: No factoring or supplier finance is visible, but obligations are moving off the balance sheet at scale through guarantees, purchase commitments, uncommenced leases and unconsolidated VIEs, and a license payment is classified as financing.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.dropped: finding: a number written in the analyst's own words: 'ment member was renamed between the two 10-Qs at the same value. Related parties'

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: Every notes item carrying an expected direction was tested against the numbers: of sixty-one items, thirty-three are confirmed, three are contradicted and twenty-five are unresolved, as listed in the reconciliation. The contradictions: the MD&A's statement that critical accounting estimates are unchanged against tagged new Level-three warrants, VIE exposure, upward private valuation adjustments and guarantee exposure of {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}; the expected downward effect of provisions on gross margin against a quarterly gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of six filled quarters; and the release's remaining repurchase authorization against the 10-Q's tagged amount. The 8-K release and the 10-Q otherwise match where they can be compared: the release's quarterly operating cash flow equals the calculator's derived quarter of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}, the Data Center revenue sentence matches the tagged member, and the non-GAAP definition change is stated in the release's own text. The release omits the guarantee cap, the OpenAI affiliate and the residual-value support, and it prints a non-marketable securities line that aggregates differently from the tagged measurement-alternative and equity-method facts, so the two cannot be matched line for line here. The China revenue line against minimal China shipments, and the locked-up equity counted as liquidity, are confirmed tensions rather than contradictions.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: Mostly consistent on the numbers, with three contradictions that all run in the direction of a smoother story than the facts support.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: days sales of inventory for the quarter is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the highest of six filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a year earlier; on a trailing basis {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory}; inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory}, with raw materials roughly tripled from the fiscal year end and finished goods lower — a build for a product transition, not stranded finished stock, though no valuation reserve is tagged, the quarter's write-down is below the year-ago quarter, releases were taken, and the MD&A itself warns of higher provisions as Vera Rubin ramps. Purchase commitments in excess of need: supply-and-capacity commitments more than doubled in one quarter and the total future purchase commitment is far larger, scheduled out to fiscal 2032 and beyond, the cancellability wording was softened, and an excess purchase obligation charge is tagged in the quarter alongside the licensed China Hopper charge for excess inventory and purchase obligations; the calculator's purchase-obligation field is missing for this date. Customer concentration (concentration.facts): the largest direct revenue customer is {concentration.facts.35} of the quarter, below the year-ago quarter's largest at {concentration.facts.12}, but receivables are now spread over five customers at or above a tenth each, the largest at {concentration.facts.39}, against three at the fiscal year end and a top share of {concentration.facts.26} at the prior quarter end; the non-US revenue share is {concentration.facts.33}, and the 10-K tagged that most Taiwan-billed revenue is for United States and Europe end customers. Channel stuffing: the classic markers — days sales outstanding at a six-quarter high, terms extended up to one year, five large receivable debtors — are present, but customer advances and contract liabilities also rose to their highest relative to revenue, and the customers carrying extended terms are described as investment grade; the evidence is mixed and nothing in the filings shows product moved ahead of end demand. Circular or vendor-financed deals: this is the strongest finding — the company invests in AI model makers and infrastructure financiers, holds equity-method VIE stakes in financiers, commits to buy cloud services from AI clouds that buy its products, guarantees a customer's land, power and shell leases up to a cap that dominates {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}, signs data center leases it intends to reassign to third parties, receives warrants from public companies with the benefit deferred, and says one AI research company contributed meaningful revenue indirectly by buying cloud services from its customers while an affiliate of OpenAI is the customer behind the guarantee; the filing does not say whether they are the same company.
industry_lens.verdict: The industry risks are all present at once: inventory and commitments built for a ramp, concentration widening in receivables, and an ecosystem the company funds, guarantees and sells into.

anomalies.what: Payment terms of ninety days to one year for investment-grade customers are new in the note and are called financing arrangements in the MD&A, yet the note does not say whether a significant financing component is recognized or how large the extended-term receivables are; receivables stand at {terms.balances_now.receivables}.

anomalies.name: Contract liabilities and customer advances surge
anomalies.what: Current contract liabilities are {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} a year earlier, the ratio to revenue of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} is the highest of six filled quarters, and the customer-advances member rose from a small fiscal-year-end balance; the notes give amounts but no explanation of what the advances secure.

anomalies.name: Procure-and-commit arrangements with undisclosed revenue share
anomalies.what: AI clouds buy the company's products and the company commits to buy their cloud services; the platform's revenue rose strongly and the commitment is tagged, but the notes do not say how the sale and the commitment are assessed together or what share of revenue came from these partners.

anomalies.name: Deferred warrant benefit with unstated destination
anomalies.name_ko: 이연된 워런트 이익, 인식 위치 불명
anomalies.what: Warrants received from public companies are tagged from nil with a Level-three fair value, and the corresponding benefit is substantially deferred; the notes do not say who issued them, what was given for them, or whether the benefit will be recognized in revenue, cost or other income.

anomalies.name: Customer moved between platforms with prior periods recast
anomalies.name_ko: 고객 플랫폼 재분류와 과거 기간 재작성
anomalies.what: One company was moved from ACIE to Hyperscale with its prior-period revenue recast; the numbers reader prints the prior 10-Q's platform figures but not the recast comparatives, so the size of the shift is not visible.

anomalies.name: Unbilled contracts receivable tagged for the first time
anomalies.what: Unbilled contracts receivable appears for the first time in the facts read, with no earlier value and no prose explaining it.

anomalies.name: Warranty reserve ratio thinning into a product ramp
anomalies.name_ko: 신제품 양산 중 보증충당금 비율 하락
anomalies.what: The warranty reserve ratio is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}, the second lowest of six filled quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}; the accrual of {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual} is flat on the prior quarter while warranties issued and payments both rose sharply and the MD&A warns that production complexity has caused and could cause higher warranty costs.

anomalies.name: Credit-loss allowance not tagged in any period
anomalies.what: No allowance for credit losses is tagged in any period, so with receivables at {terms.balances_now.receivables}, five customers above a tenth of the balance and terms up to one year, the adequacy of the credit reserve cannot be seen.

anomalies.name: Inventory reserve untagged while releases raise income
anomalies.what: No inventory valuation reserve is tagged; trailing write-downs are {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down}, the quarter's write-down is below the year-ago quarter, and the MD&A reports provision releases from selling previously reserved inventory — an estimate change that raises income with no calculator field.

anomalies.name: Upward valuation adjustments on private holdings
anomalies.what: Upward price adjustments on non-marketable equity securities are tagged for the quarter and half at many times the year-ago amounts, under inputs such as volatility and expected time to liquidity; the MD&A confirms the quarter's equity gains were primarily unrealized.

anomalies.name: No critical estimate change claimed despite new judgments
anomalies.name_ko: 새 회계 판단에도 중요 추정 변경 없음 주장
anomalies.what: The MD&A says there have been no material changes to critical accounting estimates, while the facts tag a Level-three warrant valuation from nil, VIE exposure, upward private valuation adjustments and guarantee exposure of {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}.

anomalies.name: Guarantee fair value called not significant
anomalies.what: The land, power and shell guarantees are classified as credit derivatives with fair values called not significant; the notional is tagged but no fair value is, and the inputs behind the conclusion are not shown.

anomalies.name: Effective tax rate rose, not fell
anomalies.what: The trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate} and the quarterly rate is above the year-ago quarter; no discrete item or valuation-allowance release lifted income. A benign reading.

anomalies.name: Soft-asset share near its record
anomalies.what: The soft-asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, the second highest of six filled quarters after {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share}, and fiscal 2026 at {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share} was the highest of five years; the prose explains it with ecosystem equity investments rather than capitalized costs.

anomalies.name: Inventory and export charges recur every period
anomalies.what: Inventory and excess purchase obligation provisions appear in the quarter, the half and the prior fiscal year — {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down} over the trailing four quarters — and export-related charges and releases appear in successive quarters of fiscal 2026 and again in the first half of fiscal 2027; the release footnotes them as items affecting comparisons.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP gap not computable
anomalies.what: The release prints non-GAAP net income below GAAP after a definition change that now includes stock-based compensation but still excludes equity gains, equity-derivative gains and equity-method results; the record holds no non-GAAP concept, so the gap is unfilled in every period.

anomalies.name: Other assets nearly doubled with a deferred warrant benefit
anomalies.what: Other non-current assets nearly doubled from the fiscal year end and the prepaid-and-other-assets cash-flow line turned to a large use as warrants were booked in Other assets with the benefit substantially deferred; the prose describes the booking but not the destination of the deferred credit.

anomalies.name: Guarantee exposure multiplied
anomalies.what: Guarantee maximum exposure is {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}, almost all of it a financial guarantee tagged as a subsequent event on behalf of an OpenAI affiliate; the field is missing a year earlier and the 10-K printed a far smaller amount. The note describes the guarantees but not how they will be accounted for.

anomalies.name: Supply commitments more than doubled in one quarter
anomalies.name_ko: 공급 약정 한 분기 만에 두 배 이상
anomalies.what: Supply-and-capacity commitments more than doubled between the prior quarter end and this quarter end, and the total future purchase commitment is far larger still; the calculator's purchase-obligation field is missing for this date and was {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier.

anomalies.name: Groq license payment classified as financing
anomalies.what: The release cash-flow statement carries a Groq line under financing activities and the MD&A names it among financing outflows; the payment is outside operating and investing cash flow and so outside the release's free cash flow, and no calculator field carries it.

anomalies.name: Uncommenced leases for own use and for third parties
anomalies.name_ko: 미개시 리스: 자체 사용분과 제삼자 양도분
anomalies.what: The operating lease liability is {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.operating_lease_liability} a year earlier, and two new commitment members carry leases not yet commenced — one for own use with terms up to twenty years, one the company expects to reassign to third parties without saying whether it stays liable.

anomalies.name: Debt issuance alongside buybacks and dividends
anomalies.what: Borrowing issued is {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued}, lifting free cash flow to equity to {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity} against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}, while trailing repurchases are {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} and dividends {terms.trailing_four_quarters.dividends_paid}; the prose says the notes were for general corporate purposes.

anomalies.name: Tax payment timing shifted cash between quarters
anomalies.name_ko: 세금 납부 시점이 분기 간 현금을 이동
anomalies.what: Two federal tax payments fell in this quarter after none in the first, current taxes payable fell from the prior quarter end, and quarterly operating cash flow fell {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct}; the first quarter's cash was flattered and this quarter's depressed by timing.

anomalies.name: Infrastructure-financier VIEs not consolidated
anomalies.what: Equity-method investments in infrastructure financiers rose and those treated as VIEs carry a tagged maximum loss exposure including future commitments; management concludes it is not the primary beneficiary, and the input does not say whether the financiers fund purchases of the company's products.

anomalies.name: No factoring or supplier finance in the record
anomalies.what: The record tags neither proceeds from sale of receivables nor a supplier finance obligation in any period, and receivables are growing on the balance sheet rather than being sold; nothing found, and the finding is clean as far as the record reaches.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation as a real cost
anomalies.what: Share-based compensation over the trailing four quarters is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, subtracted in {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}; the release's non-GAAP measures now include it, and a large unrecognized balance remains to be expensed.

anomalies.name: ERP upgrade of core financial systems in progress
anomalies.name_ko: 핵심 재무시스템 ERP 전환 진행 중
anomalies.what: Controls are reported effective with no change in internal control, while a phased ERP upgrade of core financial systems continues and is evaluated each quarter; no number tests the migration.

anomalies.name: Release omits the guarantee cap and residual-value support
anomalies.name_ko: 발표문이 보증 한도와 잔여가치 지원을 누락
anomalies.what: The release describes SB Energy as a partnership that secured capacity and calls the financing platforms strategic partnerships; the 10-Q tags a guarantee cap as a subsequent event on behalf of an OpenAI affiliate and says the company may provide residual-value support under memorandums that may not become agreements.

anomalies.name: Repurchase authorization differs between release and 10-Q
anomalies.name_ko: 자사주 매입 잔여 한도, 발표문과 10-Q 불일치
anomalies.what: The release's approximate remaining repurchase authorization and the 10-Q's tagged amount at the same date are different figures; whether rounding explains the gap cannot be computed here.

anomalies.name: Prior-period revenue recast between platforms
anomalies.what: A customer's prior-period revenue was recast from ACIE into Hyperscale because its business model changed; totals are unchanged but the platform comparatives are not the ones the prior 10-Q printed, and the recast amounts are not visible in the numbers.

anomalies.name: Appeal petition sentence dropped from the litigation note
anomalies.name_ko: 소송 주석에서 항고 신청 문장 삭제
anomalies.what: The prior note ended with the company's petition to appeal the class certification; the current note drops that sentence without saying how it turned out, and the loss contingency accrual is tagged at nil.

anomalies.name: IRS examination with rising non-current tax accrual
anomalies.name_ko: IRS 세무조사와 비유동 법인세 부채 증가
anomalies.what: The IRS is examining fiscal 2023 and 2024; non-current accrued income taxes rose from the fiscal year end and the 10-K's unrecognized tax benefits rose year over year.

anomalies.name: Quarterly operating cash flow matches the release
anomalies.what: The release's three-month operating cash flow equals the calculator's derived quarter of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}; the 10-Q tags only the six-month figure, which is standard. Clean.

anomalies.name: China revenue line against minimal China shipments
anomalies.name_ko: 중국 매출 라인과 극소량 출하의 긴장
anomalies.what: The China-including-Hong-Kong revenue member roughly doubled year over year while the MD&A says Hopper shipments to China were under one percent of Data Center revenue and the outlook assumes none; the geographic table is by customer headquarters, so what the line contains is not visible.

anomalies.name: Expected provision drag versus a record gross margin
anomalies.what: The notes item expected provisions and releases to push gross margin down this quarter, but gross margin is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, up on {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.gross_margin|pct} and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} and the highest of six filled quarters; the provisions were a drag the product mix more than absorbed.

anomalies.name: Locked-up equity counted as liquidity
anomalies.what: The MD&A lists marketable equity securities as a primary liquidity source while the restricted public equity holding is tagged at most of that amount under short-term lock-ups; the numbers confirm the lock-up the notes reader flagged.

anomalies.name: Inventory days at a six-quarter high with raw materials tripled
anomalies.name_ko: 재고일수 여섯 분기 최고, 원재료 세 배
anomalies.what: Days sales of inventory is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a year earlier, inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory}, raw materials roughly tripled from the fiscal year end and finished goods fell; the prose describes supply constraints and a build for the next architecture, which fits the mix.

anomalies.name: Purchase commitments versus need, cancellability softened
anomalies.name_ko: 수요 대비 구매 약정과 완화된 취소 가능 문구
anomalies.what: Supply-and-capacity commitments more than doubled in a quarter and run out to fiscal 2032 and beyond, the note's cancellability wording weakened, and excess purchase obligation charges are tagged in the quarter alongside the licensed China Hopper charge; whether the commitments exceed need cannot be judged from the numbers.

anomalies.name: Receivables concentration widened to five customers
anomalies.what: Five direct customers each hold a tenth or more of receivables, the largest at {concentration.facts.39}, against three at the fiscal year end and a top share of {concentration.facts.26} at the prior quarter end; the largest direct revenue customer is {concentration.facts.35} of the quarter, below the year-ago quarter's {concentration.facts.12}. The widening coincides with the new extended terms.

anomalies.name: Channel-stuffing markers present but mixed
anomalies.what: Days sales outstanding at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} is a six-quarter high, terms run up to one year and five large debtors hold the receivables, but customer advances and contract liabilities rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} of revenue, the highest of six quarters, and the extended-term customers are described as investment grade; nothing shows product moved ahead of end demand.

anomalies.name: Circular ecosystem financing
anomalies.what: The company invests in AI model makers and infrastructure financiers, holds unconsolidated VIE stakes in financiers, commits to buy cloud services from AI clouds that buy its products, guarantees a customer's land, power and shell leases up to a cap that dominates {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}, signs data center leases it intends to reassign, receives warrants from public companies with the benefit deferred and may give residual-value support on financing platforms; the prose describes each arrangement and the facts tag the balances, but none of it says how much revenue flows back from the parties financed.

anomalies.name: Indirect customer and guarantee counterparty possibly the same
anomalies.name_ko: 간접 고객과 보증 상대방의 동일성 불명
anomalies.what: The MD&A says one AI research and deployment company contributed meaningful revenue by buying cloud services from the company's customers, and the notes name an OpenAI affiliate as the customer behind the guarantees; the filing does not say whether they are the same, and revenue concentration is tagged for direct customers only, the largest at {concentration.facts.35}.

adjustments.name: receivables growth tied to extended payment terms
adjustments.quote: partially offset by an increase in accounts receivable due to extended payment terms on large multi-quarter agreements with certain investment-grade customers

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름 대 순이익 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}로 회사 역사상 어느 해보다 낮고, 이번 분기 순이익은 {ratios.growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct} 늘었지만 영업현금흐름은 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} 변했습니다. 매출채권 증가 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}가 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct}를 흡수했으며, 회사는 이를 고객에게 준 장기 결제조건과 세금 납부 시점 때문이라고 설명하고 숫자는 그 설명을 뒷받침합니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 매출채권 회수기간은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 여섯 분기 중 가장 길고, 회사는 투자등급 고객에게 최장 일 년의 결제조건을 준다고 새로 밝혔습니다. 반면 계약부채는 {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}로 늘어 고객 선수금이 쌓이고 있으며, 제품을 사는 AI 클라우드에서 서비스를 되사는 약정과 이연된 워런트 이익 등 새로운 회계 판단은 설명이 부족합니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 보증충당금 비율은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}로 여섯 분기 중 두 번째로 낮은데, 보증 발생과 지급은 크게 늘었고 회사 스스로 신제품 양산이 보증비용을 높일 수 있다고 경고합니다. 대손충당금과 재고평가충당금은 기록에 없고, 비상장 투자 평가이익이 이익을 끌어올리는데도 회사는 중요한 추정 변경이 없다고 말합니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 개발비 자본화는 없고 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}는 전액 비용 처리됩니다. 다만 무형성 자산 비중이 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}로 높은 수준이고, 재고 평가손실과 수출 관련 비용이 매 기간 반복됩니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망 금융은 기록에 없지만, 보증 최대노출액이 {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}로 급증했고 공급 약정과 미개시 리스가 재무상태표 밖에서 크게 늘었습니다. Groq 라이선스 대금은 재무활동으로 분류되어 잉여현금흐름 계산에서 빠지며, 차입 {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued}이 자사주 매입과 배당 일부를 조달했습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 내부통제는 유효하다고 보고되었고 감사인이나 재무책임자 변경은 없지만, 핵심 재무시스템의 ERP 전환이 진행 중입니다. 실적 발표문은 10-Q가 공시한 보증 한도와 잔여가치 지원을 언급하지 않고, 자사주 매입 잔여 한도 숫자도 두 문서가 다릅니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 방향이 제시된 주석 항목 예순한 개 중 서른세 개는 숫자가 확인하고 세 개는 반박하며 스물다섯 개는 판단할 수 없습니다. 반박된 세 가지는 중요한 추정 변경이 없다는 설명, 충당금이 매출총이익률을 낮춘다는 방향({trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}로 여섯 분기 중 최고), 그리고 발표문과 10-Q의 자사주 매입 잔여 한도입니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일로 여섯 분기 중 가장 길고 원재료가 급증했으며, 공급 약정은 한 분기 만에 두 배 이상으로 늘었습니다. 매출채권은 다섯 고객에 집중되고, 회사는 고객에게 투자하고 보증을 서며 그 고객의 클라우드를 되사는 순환 구조 속에서 판매하고 있습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
